name: Carbon tax (carbon component of Mineral Oil Tax) on auto-diesel
law: Finance Act 1999 Schedule 2A, as Revenue's Excise Duty Rates manual gives it: the carbon component of Mineral Oil Tax on heavy oil used as a propellant (auto-diesel) charges 71.00 euro per tonne of CO2 its burning emits. Fuel suppliers pay it with the Mineral Oil Tax and pass it on in the fuel price. The manual says the increase legislated for 2026 is postponed to 1 May 2027, so this rate ends the day before.

sources.title: Revenue (Ireland): energy excise duty rates, Mineral Oil Tax with its carbon component and the amount charged per tonne of CO2, with previous rates
